children: Cal announced Nasdaq has closed its MVLS non-compliance after meeting alternative stockholders’ equity criteria, while the minimum $1 bid-price issue remains unresolved.
Nasdaq closed MVLS non-compliance after Cal reported $5,513,000 in stockholders’ equity for quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Cal continues to be non-compliant with Nasdaq’s $1.00 minimum bid-price rule and has until Sept 14, 2026 to regain compliance.
Cal implemented a one-for-five reverse stock split of common stock effective Aug 28, 2026 to address the low share price.
No assurance provided that Cal will regain or maintain compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements.
